what_it_does: RedSan profiles already-optimized GPU CUDA programs to find redundant memory operations. It uses binary instrumentation (patching compiled code without needing source files) to detect unnecessary loads and stores that can be removed. The tool was tested on standard graphics and machine learning benchmarks including image processing and deep learning workloads. It identifies optimization opportunities that conventional GPU profiling tools miss because those tools focus only on identifying performance hotspots rather than removing wasted work.
